audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-5 rendered 'Skill' and the two-item row rendered 'Fiora', which inverts the actual shape of the lane and contradicts the mirror.
audit.why: The audited fiora__volibear entry sets win[1..5] to Fiora and win[6] to Skill, with the full-layer sides flipped as one group.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Fiora, row 6 to Skill, as matched full/content pairs; ratings 4,4,4,4,4 then 5. Row 0 stays Fiora. Every affected why rewritten to support its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and spikes[1] built the levels 4-5 and level 6 spikes on Volibear's ultimate, which is not available at 4-5 and does not win the duel at 6; no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1 and its real value here is the tower disable for a dive. Fiora's timings are Riposte 24/22/20/18/16s, Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7s, Grand Challenge 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: Those numbers written into early, mid, late, all four spikes, whys[3], whys[4] and phases[1-6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Riposte 'parries your Q-stun' but never stated the consequence, and spikes[1] claimed Volibear's R 'makes your CC hard for her to Riposte cleanly'.
audit.why: Riposte parries ALL incoming damage and disables, then stabs: it slows the first champion hit, or STUNS them if it blocked an immobilizing effect. Charging Thundering Smash into an up Riposte does not merely waste the stun — it hands her a stun on you. Nothing about Stormbringer changes how cleanly she can parry. Duelist's Dance vitals also restore health and grant move speed on every hit, which is what makes her extended trades work.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[0], mid, phases[1].why, phases[2].why, phases[5].why, spikes[2] and wants.you[2].

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Fiora has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Riposte (24s at rank 1) parries all damage and stuns you if it blocks your Thundering Smash. Level 2 is hers.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Fiora under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Duelist's Dance vitals heal her and give move speed. Level 3 is hers — stand so the revealed vital faces the wave, not you.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Fiora down every time Riposte is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: Lunge falls to 7.75s at rank 4 and applies on-hit. Levels 4-5 stay hers unless Riposte is on its 24s and you commit inside it.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Fiora under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Grand Challenge (110s) reveals all four vitals and heals her and her allies if she lands them. Level 6 is hers, not yours.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Fiora to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Her first item cashes the vitals: Bladework's second attack crits, and each vital hit restores health and move speed.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Fiora can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items it evens out: you survive her vital rotation, but only ever open a trade after Riposte's 16s at rank 5 has been spent.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 your Stormbringer setup and E-slow swing the all-in to you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay hers: Lunge drops to 7.75s and vitals heal her back.

edits.before: At 6 your R re-cast and slow out-run her Grand Challenge chase.
edits.after: At 6 Grand Challenge (110s) reveals all four vitals and heals her.

edits.before: With 2+ items your tankiness and repeatable R out-duel her once W is down.
edits.after: With 2+ items it evens — you survive her vitals if Riposte is spent.

edits.before: This is Fiora's window — her Lunge (Q) pokes you down and her Riposte (W) parries your Q-stun, so never throw your engage into an up W or she stuns you instead; only trade when her W is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is Fiora's window — Riposte (24s at rank 1) parries all incoming damage, and if it blocks your Thundering Smash stun it stuns YOU instead. Never open into an up Riposte; trade only on its cooldown.

edits.before: Stormbringer flips it: your R re-cast makes your dashes/CC hard for her to Riposte cleanly, and E-slow plus your passive DPS out-runs her Grand Challenge (R) vital chase before she completes the heal.
edits.after: Level 6 is hers, not yours: Grand Challenge (110s) reveals all four vitals and heals her and nearby allies if she lands them. Stormbringer's tower disable is the dive, not the duel.

edits.before: After first item Fiora spikes hard — her Bladework (E) attack-speed and vital procs let her shred your HP and heal off Grand Challenge; don't sit in her vital range, kite with E and reset.
edits.after: After first item Fiora spikes hard — Bladework (11s at rank 1) gives two fast attacks and the second one crits, while every vital she hits restores health and move speed. Do not stand still.

edits.before: Late you stabilize: your tankiness and repeatable R let you survive her ult vitals and lock her down, so bait her Riposte then all-in when it and her R are down.
edits.after: Late it evens: Stormbringer's bonus health lets you survive a vital rotation, so bait Riposte, then commit once it and Grand Challenge are both spent.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is an even skill check — her Lunge (Q) out-ranges you but she can't commit yet, so it's about not walking into a Riposte.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are hers — Lunge (400 range, 13s at rank 1) out-reaches your 300-range stun, and Riposte punishes any walk-up.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Fiora's: her parry and vital poke win short trades, so wait for her W cooldown — but your level-6 Stormbringer plus E-slow swings the all-in back to you.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 are Fiora's: Riposte parries all damage and stuns you if it catches Thundering Smash, so bait it out, count the 24s, and only then commit the stun.

edits.before: Her first-item Bladework spike is dangerous, but with 2+ items your tankiness and repeatable R let you eat her vitals and out-duel her once Riposte is down.
edits.after: Her first-item Bladework spike is dangerous, but with two items Stormbringer's bonus health lets you eat a vital rotation and trade back once Riposte is spent.

edits.before: E-slow to out-run her vital chase and Bladework (E)
edits.after: Use Sky Splitter's slow to break her vital chase
